summary:
We developed an animated educational video titled Cookie's Cosmic Journey, featuring Cookie, a fictional Rover embarking on a mission to Mars. The animation combines storytelling, visual effects and on-screen explanatory captions to introduce different types of NASA space exploration hardware, including rovers, landers, scientific instruments and helicopters. 

The project addresses the challenge by transforming real NASA space hardware and mission histories into an engaging animated narrative, our project makes complex scientific information more accessible and enjoyable for school-age audiences. Through Cookie's interactions with other space explorers, viewers learn about different types of space equipment, their original purposes, the missions they supported and the scientific knowledge they helped humanity gain.

Through an engaging storyline, the animation highlights the importance of communication, scientific discovery and the lasting value of every space mission. Ultimately, it reminds us that even when explorers are far from home, their contributions are never forgotten.
details:
Cookie's Cosmic Journey is an animated educational project that introduces viewers to the fascinating world of space exploration through the adventures of Cookie, a newly launched rover sent to Mars. Throughout its journey, Cookie encounters other space exploration technologies, including rovers, landers, scientific instruments and helicopters. Through their interactions, viewers learn about their missions, technological capabilities, historical achievements and contributions to space science.

The project combines storytelling, animation and scientific information to make complex space exploration concepts more accessible and engaging. By presenting information through character interactions and narrative sequences, it transforms scientific knowledge into an enjoyable learning experience.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project aims to increase public awareness and interest in space exploration, particularly among younger audiences. It encourages curiosity about space technology while highlighting the importance of scientific research, technological innovation and international exploration efforts. More importantly, it conveys the message that every space exploration mission has value and that the contributions of these technologies should not be overlooked, even when their missions come to an end.

Tools and Technologies

The project was developed using Figma, primarily utilising its design and prototyping features to create animated scenes, character interactions and visual storytelling. Audio editing and voice-over elements were incorporated to enhance the narrative and create a more immersive viewing experience. AI-powered animation tools were also explored to generate visual sequences and bring the story to life.

Use of AI

We used several AI tools to assist in developing our project, including generating animations, creating visual elements, and refining the storyline.

1. ChatGPT: Generated images of space equipment, refined the storyline, provided guidance on Figma features, and assisted in gathering information and conducting research.

2. Doubao: Generated images of space equipment and user interface buttons.

3. Gemini: Generated images of space equipment.

4. CapCut AI: Generated video visuals and AI voices for the narrator and equipment characters.

5. Google Assistant: Assisted in gathering information and conducting research.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of this project lies in presenting space exploration from an unconventional perspective. Instead of delivering scientific information through traditional educational formats, the project personifies space exploration technologies as characters with distinct personalities, experiences and missions. Cookie serves as a narrative guide, allowing viewers to discover scientific facts naturally through conversations and encounters. This approach combines factual learning with imaginative storytelling, making the subject more relatable and memorable.

Factors Considered During Development

Several factors were considered throughout the development process, including scientific accuracy, educational value, audience engagement and narrative consistency. The team researched real space exploration technologies and their missions to ensure that the information presented was reliable.

Particular attention was also given to the characters' timelines, operational status and communication capabilities to maintain scientific credibility. In addition, animation quality, audio synchronisation, visual clarity and storytelling pace were considered to ensure a cohesive and engaging final product.
